composition.arrows: Overlapping translucent glass planes with selected luminous rim halos; crisp opaque labels sit outside the planes. Direction has one explicit terminal head.
composition.people: Overlapping translucent glass planes with selected luminous rim halos; crisp opaque labels sit outside the planes. One head and one body identify one participant; decorative backing is not another person.
composition.empty: Overlapping translucent glass planes with selected luminous rim halos; crisp opaque labels sit outside the planes. Chair back, seat and legs remain visibly unoccupied; label vacancy explicitly.
composition.pending: Overlapping translucent glass planes with selected luminous rim halos; crisp opaque labels sit outside the planes. A clock mark accompanies an explicit pending label; not a completion check.
composition.emphasis: Overlapping translucent glass planes with selected luminous rim halos; crisp opaque labels sit outside the planes. Essential labels retain a clean surface and opaque ink.
composition.warning: Overlapping translucent glass planes with selected luminous rim halos; crisp opaque labels sit outside the planes. Warning role is paired with explicit wording, not color alone.

required.description: Overlapping translucent glass planes with selected luminous rim halos; crisp opaque labels sit outside the planes.
Retain exact labels, factual object counts and locked relations; vacancy, pending and complete are different states.
Use all six resolved semantic roles without changing geometry; restricted print tones may map roles to the same spot ink.
Keep essential Japanese text upright, outside dense texture or projected planes, and inspect at the actual placement.

preferred.description: Derive principal object construction from source.svg and its explicit light/dark exports, not one reusable generic icon family.
Keep decorative texture and overlaps in picture regions; leave the label reading route clear.

flexible.description: Object positions, line breaks, motif count and routing adapt to the brief and target.
Both original variants are intrinsically dark. Remapping to a light surface requires independent contrast review; small slots lose halo character.
